item.title: Role Play Haven brings Young Dragons and charity gaming to Dragonmeet 2025
item.description: The Role Play Haven confirms its Dragonmeet 2025 lineup, including D&D, Warhammer, and a dedicated Young Dragons charity zone at the ExCeL Centre.

item.title: Original Tank Girl debut artwork heads to auction with £30k estimate
item.description: The original Page 3 artwork from Deadline #1, featuring the first appearance of Tank Girl and her tank by Jamie Hewlett, is up for auction.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #337
item.description: Paradox reviews World of Darkness and Titmouse sets a release date. Catch the last Black Friday TTRPG offers, Dragonmeet updates and Geek Native store news.

item.title: Get 7 high-profile RPGs in the 13th annual Cornucopia bundle
item.description: Get a feast of top-quality TTRPGs, including games from Monte Cook Games and the designers of Spire, in the new Cornucopia 2025 bundle.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #310 - Is the World of Darkness in trouble again?
item.description: Paradox signals a retreat from major RPG adaptations after heavy losses. We also investigate if new UK customs rules for 2029 will actually increase the cost of backing board games on Kickstarter or if exemptions keep pledges safe.

item.title: Review: Grimsbury - English Folk Horror RPG
item.description: Explore a mis-remembered 1970s England where ancient Magick clashes with the atomic age. Read our review of Grimsbury, a folk horror RPG by Chris Chaudruc using the Year Zero Engine.

item.title: Help independent news: Pick January's RPG Publisher Spotlight
item.description: Geek Native thanks the patrons keeping independent writing alive and announces GearGames as the final Spotlight of 2025. Plus, we explore how the Christmas Truce of 1914 offers vital lessons on pacing, humanity, and tension for your roleplaying games.

item.title: Rascal News price rise highlights the fight for indie TTRPG journalism
item.description: Rascal News has announced a subscription price increase for 2026 due to economic pressures.

item.title: Neverwinter and Frosthaven publisher Arc Games goes independent
item.description: Arc Games, publisher of Neverwinter and the Frosthaven video game, has separated from Embracer Group via a management buyout backed by XD Inc.

item.title: TaleSpire roadmap update reveals TitanCraft deal and future character creator
item.description: TaleSpire has announced full integration with TitanCraft, allowing users to import custom 3D miniatures directly into the virtual tabletop.
